name: extension
_comment: Registers the Platform.Bible extension as an nx project for affected detection only (the PR workflow's extension lint job keys on the name `extension`). npm scripts stay the way to build it; the one target below is never run.

metadata.description: Never run. Its `default` input (which includes nx.json's sharedGlobals) makes a shared-file change mark this project affected; the dotnet-types are imported through tsconfig's @dotnet-types path.
